name: @akoru/drama-writer
description: Claude Code skill for writing vertical short dramas and AI-video screenplays in any language, with an installer CLI.
author: AchLim

scripts.check: node scripts/sync-version.mjs --check && node scripts/build-single-file.mjs --check && node scripts/build-directory-plugin.mjs --check
scripts.zip: npm run build && node dist/cli.js export-zip --out release
scripts.version: node scripts/sync-version.mjs && node scripts/build-single-file.mjs && node scripts/build-directory-plugin.mjs && git add plugins .claude-plugin drama-writer.md
scripts.prepublishOnly: npm run check && npm run typecheck && npm test
